lessons.title: quèdìng — to be certain; to settle on
lessons.gloss: to be certain; to settle on

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for as a precaution, then the Mandarin for to fall due.
quèdìng — "to be certain; to settle on".
wǒ hái bú quèdìng míngtiān néng bu néng qù — I'm not sure yet whether I can go tomorrow.
Its characters come later; for now it is a word for the ear.

quèdìng is built from què 'firm' and dìng 'settled', both inherited from Middle Chinese, khaewk and dengH (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the first 'steadfast' and the second 'calm'.
One more word for saying what would happen.

lessons.title: 约定 (yuēdìng) — to agree on a time; to fix (a time or place) together
lessons.gloss: to agree on a time; to fix (a time or place) together

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for to fall due, then the Mandarin for to be certain.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: 约定

segments.text: 约定 — yuēdìng — "to agree on a time; to fix (a time or place) together".
我们约定明天早上八点见面 wǒmen yuēdìng míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn jiànmiàn — We agreed to meet at eight tomorrow morning.
The new character, in pieces: 定 (dìng) — eight strokes in two pieces: the roof of 安 on top, and under it the five strokes at the foot of 是. The next lesson puts it in your hand.
约定 (yuēdìng) is built from 约 'to bind' and 定 (dìng) 'settled', both inherited from Middle Chinese, 'jak and dengH (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the second 'calm'.
One more word for saying what would happen.

blocks.title: Script — the roof of 安 over the foot of 是

segments.text: 定 (dìng).
Two pieces, top before bottom.
The roof, three strokes, as on top of 安: a dot, a short stroke down on the left, and a bar that turns down and hooks.

Under it, five strokes, the foot of 是. A bar. A short vertical down from its middle. A short bar to the right of the vertical. Then a stroke falling to the left, and a long stroke falling to the right that sweeps along the foot.
3 + 5 = eight.

segments.text: How many strokes in 定 (dìng)? (Eight.) What is on top? (The roof of 安.) Where have you made the bottom piece before? (At the foot of 是.)

lessons.title: 定期 (dìngqī) — at regular intervals; periodically

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for to be certain, then the Mandarin for to agree on a time.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: 定期

segments.text: 定期 — dìngqī — "at regular intervals; periodically".
你最好定期去看医生 nǐ zuìhǎo dìngqī qù kàn yīshēng — You'd better see a doctor regularly.

定期 (dìngqī) is built from 定 (dìng) 'settled' and 期 'a set time', both inherited from Middle Chinese, dengH and gi (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the second 'a limit'. The level tone of qī is irregular, as in 星期.
One more word for saying what would happen.

lessons.title: 如期 (rúqī) — as planned (on the agreed date)

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for to agree on a time, then the Mandarin for at regular intervals.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: 如期

segments.text: 如期 — rúqī — "as planned (on the agreed date)".
要是不下雨我们就如期去山里 yàoshi bú xiàyǔ wǒmen jiù rúqī qù shān lǐ — If it doesn't rain, we'll go to the hills as planned.

如期 (rúqī) is built from 如 'as' and 期 'a set time', both inherited from Middle Chinese, nyo and gi (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the first 'like' and the second 'an appointed meeting'.
One more word for saying what would happen.

lessons.title: 大约 (dàyuē) — approximately; roughly (a time or number)

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for at regular intervals, then the Mandarin for on the agreed date.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: 大约

segments.text: 大约 — dàyuē — "approximately; roughly (a time or number)".
yàoshi bù dǔchē wǒ dàyuē bā diǎn dào — If there's no traffic, I'll be there at about eight.

大约 (dàyuē) is built from 大 'big' and 约 'to bind', both inherited from Middle Chinese, dajH and 'jak (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the second 'to tie up' and 'sparing'. How the pair came to mean 'roughly' is not settled.
One more word for saying what would happen.
